pricing: Individual therapy: $165 per 50-minute session. I accept select insurance plans, so out-of-pocket costs vary by plan. A limited number of reduced-fee spots may be available.
long:
Saver Psychotherapy is a space for adults who want to understand themselves more deeply and create meaningful change. I work with people navigating trauma, anxiety, relationship and attachment patterns, grief, and life transitions. My approach is warm, collaborative, and gently direct: we’ll explore your story while building awareness of your nervous system and the patterns showing up in your life now.
I draw from EMDR, parts work, somatic practices, and mindfulness, tailoring our work to your needs. I offer virtual therapy, with limited in-person availability in Denver.
